forecast.type_id: skip: row ordinal; used only for a stable row order
forecast.type: chart-dist, map-regions, chart-timeline — splits region rows (Map) from warning/forecast rows (Content)
forecast.name: map-regions, insight:north_south, insight:warning — region code keys the map centre; Warning/OneDay/TwoDay pick the content rows
forecast.title: map-regions, insight:elevated, insight:north_south — region name in the region list and map
forecast.air_quality: chart-dist, map-regions, kpi:high, kpi:worst, insight:distribution, insight:elevated, insight:north_south
forecast.file_link: map-regions — per-region link to the ministry's settlements list (gov.il only)
forecast.fill_color: chart-dist, map-regions — the ministry's own level colour for the region swatches and map circles
forecast.show: insight:warning — whether the last warning is currently active
forecast.content: insight:warning — full warning text shown in the warning card
